blocks.text: Your after-hours access to the building has now been approved, and building management has added you to the weekend entry roster under Michelle Rose, so your existing badge should carry you through the lobby doors outside of office hours as well as during them.

Please try the badge at the side entrance before you rely on it for a weekend, and if it does not read on the first pass, let me know and I will take it up with the management office directly instead of leaving you waiting at the door.
